 Jalen Johnson nears triple-double Wednesday 
 by Ari Koslow | Hawks Correspondent | Thu, Oct 29th 2026, 2:58am EDT 
 Jalen Johnson scored 12 points (4-12 FG, 2-4 3PT, 2-3 FT) to go along with nine rebounds, 11 assists and two blocks in the Hawks 129-117 loss against the Heat. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 It was not a huge scoring performance for Johnson, but he continues to deliver in terms of contributing in other areas. He was just one rebound shy of a triple-double.
